item.title: Loose Manhole Cover at junction, 29th October
item.description:
There is a loose manhole cover in the road directly outside the Tesco Express on the corner between Hornsey Road and Tollington Rd. The road is busy, and every vehicle that passes over it makes the cover clatter loudly. This goes on late into the night and early in the morning, and it is regularly keeping me (and, I suspect, my neighbours) awake. It also seems likely to get worse, and a cover that is rocking in its frame is a safety risk for cyclists and motorists. This issue has been ongoing for several months.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 297, Hornsey Road, Holloway, Greater London
